coverage.characterIdentityScope: 18 image bases and 10 additional poses; the immutable native game still has 17 profiles. Carlyle is a context-specific medic visual and worker is an existing fallback, not two new native actors.

validation.sha256AndGitBlobSha: 119 historical PNGs verified against Git 8cb25462 and a pinned inventory digest; two new PNG hashes pinned separately.
validation.manualAnchorInspection: Ready/crouch/dodge and two unarmed walk poses, weapons, stretchers, parasites, doors, six effects and equipment inspected as source images; scoped placement review is recorded in VALIDATION.json/nativeCanvas.
validation.renderedPlacement: 13 continuation assets visually reviewed in real Canvas fixtures; the full fixture run drew 103 distinct PNG kinds. Evidence: docs/mer-des-chagrins-20261126/VALIDATION.json nativeCanvas. No browser journey or universal pose/state coverage certified.

bibleContinuation.scope: Source images inspected and source-pixel anchors calibrated. The previous 13 placement proofs and 103-type Canvas fixture result are preserved separately; no new rendered placement is certified here.

remainingWork: creatures/adult, creatures/queen, weapons/plasma and weapons/flame have no PNG and use native presentation.
Four unarmed walking key poses are available. Complete walking, firing, reloading and interaction animation cycles remain absent; two contacts plus two passing poses do not certify a complete cycle.
Support hand points are measured but the current adapter aligns the primary grip only; secondary-hand anatomy and grip occlusion require additional art.

133 PNGs are registered: 126 renderer mappings, four interface-only equipment images and three bible/gallery-only illustrations. Mappings are not a claim of natural appearances: worker is a fallback without a placed actor, four named humans have portraits without individual scenes, and the isolated egg hook has no active architecture call established. Industrial door PNGs remain restricted to compatible front/back bulkhead bays.
Documented novel identities and roles do not establish exact faces, costumes or equipment silhouettes; these drawings remain project adaptations.
Crouch/dodge drawings retain the native 85.8-unit pose envelope but their independent anatomy is not a registered full-body animation rig; cross-pose head proportions need further art refinement.

The 12 bible-continuation images are source-inspected only until a separate real-renderer QA. Partial primary descriptions do not certify complete designs; clipboard, medicine cup and Chicago tram have no new gameplay interaction.

provenance.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one single isolated game asset for a detailed realistic 2D side-view science-fiction game, Alien: Sea of Sorrows. Neutral orthographic SIDE VIEW facing right, whole object fully visible with 8 percent transparent margin, practical worn industrial materials, sharp legible silhouette, muted grey/olive hardware, detailed painted/prerendered game-art quality. No character, no collage, no sheet, no text, no watermark, no scenery, no floor, no shadow, no glow halo. Genuine transparent alpha background required. Subject: one horizontal medical cryogenic stasis capsule from a grounded retro-industrial colony facility. Empty long rectangular light-grey base on short mechanical feet, one smooth closed transparent curved canopy with subtle cyan-tinted reflections, recessed padded medical bed visible, compact control panel built into the left end and maintenance seams. Unit shown in direct side elevation, width approximately three times height. No patient or parasite inside. One connected complete capsule only, no surrounding room.

provenance.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one single isolated game asset for a detailed realistic 2D side-view science-fiction game, Alien: Sea of Sorrows. Neutral orthographic SIDE VIEW facing right, whole object fully visible with 8 percent transparent margin, practical worn industrial materials, sharp legible silhouette, muted grey/olive hardware, detailed painted/prerendered game-art quality. No character, no collage, no sheet, no text, no watermark, no scenery, no floor, no shadow, no glow halo. Genuine transparent alpha background required. Subject: one handheld foamer device for capturing a fictional alien with pale foam, short wide round nozzle pointing right, chunky industrial sprayer casing, compact sealed foam reservoir attached beneath, rear pistol grip and forward support handle. Practical rescue/capture equipment with a simple pressure gauge, worn muted yellow-grey accents. The device is inactive with no spray, no target. One standalone whole device only; no separate accessories.
